title: PPI Dosing Per CYP2C19 Genotype
official: A Pilot Study to Assess Healing of Erosive Esophagitis in Patients Randomized to Conventional PPI Doses Versus Dosing Based on CYP2C19 Genotype
summary: This study is being done to determine if the dosing of proton pump inhibitor (PPI) medication based on CYP2C19 genotype-derived phenotype leads to improved healing of erosive esophagitis compared to conventional PPI medication dosing.

interventions.name: CYP2C19 based dosing Proton Pump Inhibitors

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* age ≥ 18 years
* diagnosis of Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD) scheduled for an esophagogastroduodenoscopy (EGD)
* patients diagnosed with Erosive Esophagitis on endoscopy (EGD).

Exclusion Criteria:

* age \<18 years
* diagnosed with non-erosive reflux disease (NERD)
* pregnancy
